sn51.2:1.1: Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave cattāro iddhipadā viraddhā viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī ||
sn51.2:1.2: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā āraddhā āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || ||
sn51.2:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.2:1.8: Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime cattāro iddhipādā viraddhā viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī ||
sn51.2:1.9: yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime cattāro iddhipādā āraddhā || āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || || 2. Cattāro
